jobs.description:
About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

How we work

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:

  1. Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.
  2. Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.
  3. Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.
  4. Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.
  5. Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.
  6. Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.
  7. Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.
  8. Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.

If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit.

Want to learn more? Read and listen:

We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take.

About this role:

We believe technology will play a critical role in enabling the next generation of cash delivery operations: from identifying recipients without needing to knock on doors to a modern payments infrastructure that gets dollars in recipients’ hands faster and more scalable. We are seeking a Technical Program Associate responsible for implementing and managing the technology used across our programs - including systems for recipient data collection, verification, payments, and monitoring.

In this role, you will own all technology-related aspects of new project launches: working with our operations team to define and implement program requirements, project managing the implementation across multiple stakeholders, and analyzing, structuring, and acting on program data. You are a systems thinker who is comfortable assessing tradeoffs and deriving and communicating data-driven insights. You enjoy learning about technology in a variety of business contexts. You naturally take ownership, can navigate unfamiliar settings, and enjoy both building and managing ops. You can excel at both 10,000 feet as well as in the weeds of complex problems.

Reports to: Senior Technical Program Manager

Level: Open to Associate or Manager, depending on the candidate. We would rather find the right person than fill a predetermined level. A candidate with deeper experience, stronger technical skills, and the judgment to run their own projects and think critically and propositionally on project designs will be brought in at the higher end, with correspondingly more independence.

Location: At this stage of GiveDirectly’s growth and scale, we’re prioritizing hiring in the countries below, where we can employ you through a GD entity or an established employer of record: Cameroon, Canada, Colombia, DRC, Germany, Ghana, Kenya, Malawi, Mozambique, Netherlands, Nigeria, Poland, Portugal, Rwanda, South Africa, Spain, Turkey, Uganda, United Kingdom, and United States. This list reflects where our employment infrastructure is established today, and may evolve as we grow. If you’re based elsewhere and not open to relocation, we may not be able to consider your application for this role right now, but we’d encourage you to check back. Please also note that regardless of location, we expect 3 hours of daily overlap with the East Africa timezone.

Travel Requirement: Must be able to travel ~1-2 times per year to one of our countries of operation for team retreats or field visits.

What you’ll do:

  • Manage end-to-end technical delivery for program launches - leading scoping, requirements gathering, system configuration and implementation, QA and testing, troubleshooting, and closeout
  • Collaborate with Operations, Product, Research, Engineering, and Data teams to ensure systems are aligned with program objectives and work seamlessly in field conditions
  • Debug and resolve issues across multiple layers of our technology stack, including our recipient database and offline survey app
  • Scope and manage cross-cutting systems improvements to improve efficiency, scale, and/or recipient experience, with mentorship
  • Ensure all systems comply with GD’s standards for data protection, privacy, and financial controls
  • Manage technical training and onboarding for operations staff and collaborators
  • Lead retrospectives on program launches and technical incidents to contribute to continued system improvements

What you’ll bring:

  • Exceptional alignment with GiveDirectly Values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity. We welcome and strongly encourage applications from candidates who have personal or professional experience in the low-income and/or historically marginalized communities that we serve.
  • Language Requirement: fluent in English.
  • 3+ years of professional experience; we welcome a wide range of relevant backgrounds (e.g. project management, product management, data analytics, international development, management consulting)
  • Strong data skills: able to leverage tools to extract, clean, manipulate, and analyze data to make operational decisions.
  • Strong project management experience: experience in managing timelines, stakeholders, and complex deliverables.
  • Deep comfort with Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets.
  • Intermediate experience using a programming or scripting language (most commonly Python at GD) to automate workflows, validate data, or implement business logic. Note: This is not an engineering or data science job.
  • Significant interest in technology, systems design and building.
  • High attention to detail and strong instincts for analysis and validating data creatively and rigorously.
  • Structured approach to problem-solving and a drive to uncover and fix root causes rather than surface-level issues.
  • Ability to collaborate inclusively with stakeholders across varied social, national, and cultural backgrounds, including communicating technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Preferred, not required: Experience working with relational databases (e.g. SQL).

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

The total compensation for this role at the Associate and Manager level is broken down below. If you are based outside of the US or Kenya, specific compensation details can be provided during the initial recruiter screen.

Associate-level

  • Base salary: US $92,400 · KE $52,400
  • Bonus target: 10%
  • Benefits stipends: US $21,393 · KE $8,454

Manager-level

  • Base salary: US $107,070 · KE $72,550
  • Bonus target: 10%
  • Benefits stipends: US $21,393 · KE $8,454

Working at GiveDirectly

GiveDirectly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to the person’s race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Flagging for US applicants: We invite you to "Know Your Rights" as an applicant.

Commitment to Safeguarding

As a global organization working with communities to eliminate extreme poverty, GiveDirectly takes the safeguarding of its recipients, staff, and partners seriously. To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. We may also employ other robust pre-hire screens, including in-depth reference checks, criminal background checks, and sanctions screens.

These efforts help us continue to build and maintain trust with the communities we work with, and prevent abuse to our recipients and staff.

**GD is committed to observing all local, national and international laws that protect people and basic human rights of all. GD is committed to a policy of “zero tolerance when it comes to preventing, reporting, or responding to any form of abuse or exploitation.” and expects anyone who works for GD to uphold the protection and safeguarding of our recipients as a priority.**

Reasonable Accommodations

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the role, please email us at with the email subject “Accommodation Needed”. We will work with you to ensure reasonable accommodations are made to support your needs.

Want to put your best foot forward on your GiveDirectly application? Take a look at our Candidate Application Prep Guide!

Referrals

Know the right person for this role? Please consider referring them. We offer a reward of $3,000 for a Senior Manager or above role, and $500 for a Manager role, paid if we end up hiring your referral. Thank you for sending great people our way!

jobs.description:
Klaviyo Specialist (Full-Time, Remote)

We are hiring an experienced Klaviyo Specialist for our client, a growing retention email marketing agency that has generated over $30 million in revenue for subscription eCommerce brands.

This role is for someone who knows Klaviyo inside out, has experience managing multiple agency accounts, and can independently execute high-performing email campaigns and flows.

A Day in This Role

You start your day inside Klaviyo, reviewing campaigns and automated flows across your client accounts.

One brand needs its subscription cancellation flow updated. Another has an abandoned cart flow that needs testing, while a third has a campaign scheduled to go live.

You check the segmentation, triggers, links, and tracking to make sure everything is working before launch.

Throughout the day, you collaborate with the CSM, Project Manager, Designer, and Copywriter to keep campaigns moving.

You end the day knowing your work has helped multiple eCommerce brands run stronger retention email programs.

Must-Have Requirements

Please apply only if you meet all five requirements:

  1. 2+ years of hands-on Klaviyo experience working with eCommerce brands generating $1M+ in monthly revenue.

  2. Subscription eCommerce experience, including cancellation and downgrade flows, and integrations with Skio, Loop, Recharge, Ordergroove, or similar platforms.

  3. Agency experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously. Freelance-only or in-house-only experience is not sufficient.

  4. Experience managing 5+ accounts independently while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.

  5. Strong written English (B2+ minimum) and the ability to communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous team.

What You'll Do

  • Build, manage, and optimize Klaviyo flows, including Welcome, Abandoned Cart, Post-Purchase, Winback, and subscription retention flows.

  • Build, schedule, and launch email campaigns across multiple client accounts.

  • Perform pre-launch QA, checking segmentation, triggers, links, rendering, and tracking.

  • Monitor deliverability, maintain list hygiene, and run A/B tests to improve performance.

  • Collaborate with the CSM, Project Manager, Designer, and Copywriter to deliver campaigns accurately and on time.

This Role Is Not for You If

  • You have general email marketing experience but limited hands-on Klaviyo expertise.

  • You've only worked as a freelancer or in-house marketer without agency experience.

  • You haven't worked with subscription eCommerce brands or built cancellation and downgrade flows.

  • You need constant supervision or struggle to manage multiple client accounts independently.

  • You frequently miss deadlines, overlook campaign details, or struggle with written communication.

Why Join?

  • Work with established seven-figure subscription eCommerce brands.

  • Enjoy a fully remote role with autonomy over your daily schedule.

  • Join a small, experienced team focused on delivering measurable results.

  • Grow your career with a clear path from Klaviyo Specialist to Client Success Manager.

Ready to Apply?

If you have proven Klaviyo agency experience, understand subscription eCommerce, and can confidently manage multiple accounts without constant supervision, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now!

ALL CONTENT BELOW IS FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY

As the Head of CX Automation & AI, own and scale the comprehensive AI and automation strategy across the CX landscape, refining current infrastructures while uncovering high-impact opportunities to embed AI into internal processes and customer journeys. You will lead and develop a dedicated team with strong analytical foundations, maximizing automated resolution and driving global brand loyalty for millions of travelers through superior customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and scale Holafly's AI and automation strategy across the entire CX landscape, spanning both customer-facing and agent-facing experiences, identifying and prioritizing high-impact opportunities to embed conversational AI and automation into key user journeys, not limited to any single tool or channel.

  • Lead the team's roadmap and project planning, prioritizing initiatives and resourcing; collaborate with Product and Project Managers when they lead specific initiatives that require this team's execution.

  • Lead and grow an elite AI & Automation team (currently [X people]), including working closely with the team's current manager as part of the broader team, building on the team's strengths, and raising the technical bar in engineering practices, automation architecture, and AI implementation.

  • Architect and continuously refine the CX automation infrastructure, from chatbot and CX platform to agent-facing tools (e.g., agent assist, QA automation), ensuring frictionless, context-rich handovers between bots and human agents.

  • Track and act on essential CX and automation metrics on a regular basis, including CCR (containment rate), deflection rate, escalation rate, FCR, CSAT, drop-off rate, repeat contact rate, and intent recognition accuracy, combining quantitative interaction logs and qualitative Voice of Customer insights to proactively eliminate journey friction.

  • Report on cost-per-contact and containment-driven savings as the business outcome of this work, alongside quality trade-offs, to leadership.

  • Establish robust AI governance frameworks aligned with data privacy, responsible AI practices, and international regulatory baselines like the EU AI Act.

  • Own incident management across the CX automation stack, covering both technical issues (outages, bugs) and customer-impacting incidents (e.g., problematic automated responses), ensuring fast triage, resolution, and clear communication.

  • Own the relationship with CX platform and AI technology providers, managing vendor performance, contract and commercial terms, product roadmap influence, and escalations, and evaluating vendor fit as the business evolves.

  • Act as a hands-on AI advisor and stakeholder on self-service and cross-functional initiatives led by Product, IT, and Customer Journeys teams, ensuring AI strategy stays consistent and high-quality across the entire CX ecosystem, even where execution sits outside this team.

Qualifications

  • Proven track record of defining, deploying, and scaling sophisticated LLM, chatbot, and AI-driven automation projects across a broad CX ecosystem, in live production environments.

  • Demonstrated experience leading and upskilling technical teams, someone who can coach and elevate capability, not just direct.

  • Deep technical mastery of NLP, prompt engineering, complex data workflows, and conversational architecture, with the ability to translate that expertise into practical guidance for the team.

  • Expertise in conversational platform optimization, agent-facing AI tools, and context-driven human-agent fallback loops.

  • Experience managing technology vendor relationships, including commercial negotiations and holding providers accountable to SLAs and roadmap commitments.

Nice to Have

  • Background in travel-tech, global mobility, or hyper-growth e-commerce.

  • Familiarity with predictive analytics for intent recognition, churn modeling, and automated data tracking.

  • Experience mentoring and upskilling technical talent into stronger engineering practice.

Benefits & Perks

  • 100% remote flexibility, open to candidates based in EMEA, Northern Europe, or Africa.

  • Flexible working hours that support work-life balance and well-being.

  • Real ownership and autonomy to shape the technical future of a global market leader.

We are FundCount, an international fintech company with a 20-year track record of delivering innovative solutions. Our unified software platform powers investment, general, and partnership accounting, providing operational efficiency and insights to family offices,
fund administrators, and alternative fund managers worldwide. We’re looking for a Manual QA Engineer to join our growing Quality Assurance team.

As part of our team, you’ll play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our product. You'll engage in manual testing to uncover bugs and work closely with our development team to ensure flawless releases. We are a fully remote company, and you can work from anywhere except Russia and Belarus.

About the Product & Team:

Our technology stack includes:

  • Java (Hibernate, Spring, Swing, JUnit4, Mockito)
  • Gradle
  • PostgreSQL, MySQL
  • Git

We follow a one-month release cycle, freezing code two weeks before each release. We document our processes in Confluence and manage our tasks in Jira (in English). The development team primarily communicates in Russian via Slack. Our QA team consists of 8 engineers.

What you will do:

  • Perform thorough manual testing of desktop and web applications.
  • Write detailed bug reports in Jira.
  • Create and maintain test cases in TestRail.
  • Collaborate with developers and product teams throughout the development lifecycle.

What we expect from you:

  • 2+ years of experience in manual testing.
  • Solid understanding of Agile methodologies, SDLC, and CI/CD practices.
  • Intermediate or higher English proficiency (written).
  • Ability to independently research and gather information from documentation and public sources.
  • Adaptability to work with different technologies and tools, with a focus-solving rather than specific experience.

Technical Skills:

  • Experience testing both desktop and web (frontend and backend) applications.
  • Proficient in SQL and the ability to write DML queries.
  • Confident in working with Windows/Linux terminals.Experience with version control systems (Git).
  • Ability to read and interpret application logs and troubleshoot stack traces.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages like PowerShell, Bash, or cmd/bat.

Would be nice if:

  • Basic programming knowledge in any language.
  • Experience or interest in accounting, finance, or investment (e.g., personal involvement in stock markets).

We will be glad to offer you:

  • Fully remote work with a flexible schedule.
  • Corporate benefits.
  • Transparent processes with minimal bureaucracy.

If you’re ready to contribute to a fast-growing fintech company and work with a talented team, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today!

We are seeking an experienced English into Armenian Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client.

You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content.

What You Will Do

    -Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data.
    -Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
    -Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time.

What You Will Own

    -The community’s shared understanding of quality
    -The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
    -The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking

Requirements

    - Quality audit frameworks:     Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping

    - Analytical approach:     Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements
    - Language:     Native-level Armenian and professional-level English
    - Preferred: Prior experience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools

Additional Key Information

jobs.description:
Role Title: Family Medicine Hospitalist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Family Medicine Hospitalist Physicians to contribute their medical expertise to a customer project focused on inpatient care and documentation standards. In this role, you’ll apply your broad clinical training to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Scope of Work

  1. Review medical records, including FHIR data and clinical notes, for AI training.
  2. Check whether clinical information and claims are supported by the medical record.
  3. Review inpatient documentation, including HPI, PMH, assessments, and plans.
  4. Follow clear guidelines and apply the same standards consistently.
  5. Identify missing, incorrect, or inconsistent information in medical records.
  6. Share feedback to help improve AI models and data quality.
  7. Communicate clearly with the project team about your work and findings.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. At least 5 years of hospitalist experience.
  2. MD or DO, board certified in Family Medicine (or Family Medicine with a Hospital Medicine focus or certification).
  3. Current or recent inpatient/hospitalist experience (within the last 2 years).
  4. Strong understanding of inpatient documentation and hospital workflows, including admission, daily progress notes, transitions of care, and discharge.
  5. Comfortable reviewing clinical notes and raw medical record data.
  6. Strong attention to detail and ability to follow clear guidelines consistently.
  7. Experience with chart review, clinical documentation improvement, utilization review, or medical coding/QA is a plus.
  8. Experience across a broad patient mix, such as adult medicine, geriatrics, pediatrics, or obstetric/newborn care, is a plus. Family medicine’s cross-population training is especially valuable here.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

jobs.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Are you a passionate and curious individual with a relentless drive for delivering successful software implementations? Do you enjoy tackling large-scale, complex problems and leading high-energy teams focused on transforming the way Life Sciences companies bring drugs to market?
We are looking for a senior, self-motivated Lead Consultant to join our Professional Services team. You'll be at the forefront of our mission, leading a team of Veeva colleagues and working side-by-side with one of our key enterprise customers. As a primary customer liaison, you will build long-term relationships and act as a customer advocate, guiding them in the adoption of industry best practices and providing value through agile delivery.
You'll leverage your existing background in Life Sciences software implementation and program/project management while innovating and developing novel approaches to project delivery. You’ll be responsible for empowering enterprise companies with best-of-breed cloud-based technology.

What You'll Do

  • Lead a key enterprise customer in the IT Operations and implementation of Veeva Quality Cloud suite
  • Manage a multi-year, multi-phased global implementation program, overseeing all aspects of program and project management, including resource planning, team leadership, project tracking, and forecasting
  • Act as the primary customer liaison, managing all communication and relationships between the project team, customer, and internal stakeholders
  • Oversee customer release management programs and IT operations for Veeva Quality Cloud suite
  • Analyze customer requirements and new product features to develop customer adoption and enhancement roadmaps
  • Mentor project teams and junior consultants within the Quality Services organization
  • Guide customers in adopting Quality Cloud and industry best practices as part of post-implementation programs focused on continuous improvement

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in IT Project Management, Consulting, or Product Management, with a proven track record of leading system implementation projects
  • Experience leading large-scale Enterprise projects
  • Proven ability to work both independently and in teams in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience in assembling, planning, resourcing, budgeting, and leading project teams
  • Experience designing and executing on effective project governance models for large enterprises
  • Strong technical affinity and/or hands-on experience with software implementation
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to engage with senior/executive-level stakeholders
  • Good understanding of SaaS and GxP principles
  • Ability to travel 25-50%; easy access to an airport
  • Must be legally authorized to be employed in the EU. Veeva Systems does not anticipate providing sponsorship for employment visa status for this position

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience with eContent Management systems such as Veeva Vault, TrackWise, OpenText, SharePoint, Documentum, MasterControl, EtQ, FirstDoc/FirstPoint, or NextDocs
  • Experience in the Life Sciences Quality, Clinical, Regulatory, and/or Drug Safety spaces
  • PMP, Prince2, or Agile Scrum Master certification
  • Experience with Agile methodology and/or ACP Certification
  • Change management experience
  • Experience with PMO organizations

Interviewing with Veeva

    We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Compensation
